snippet.title: Life's Too Short Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
A little adventure game featuring a problem solving ghost. In Life's Too Short, this little ghostly adventure game, you have been called in to settle a feud between two vampires who have dramatically fallen out.

Life's Too Short originally launched on Playdate back in 2022 and after a Gameboy remake, now comes to PC in 2026.

Available now on steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4209750/Lifes_Too_Short
